sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Cloud-based EMR and PM platform, 15+ years experience, specialty-specific modules, Houston TX. Key features: charting, e-prescribing, scheduling, billing, patient portal, mobile apps.

ONC mandatory disclosures and certification page. Lists certified criteria, notes about data portability, mentions images/non-standard docs require separate export fees. NewCrop and Surescripts integrations noted.
Practice solutions page. Describes EMR and PM modules, cloud architecture, multi-practice support, ICD-10, document management, fax capabilities.
Dedicated nAble IVF product site. Reports 200+ providers, 1M+ completed cycles, $800M+ payments processed. Lists named fertility clinic customers.
Detailed IVF feature list: scheduling, evaluations, cycle management, cryostorage, lab/embryology, billing, patient portal, analytics, mobile apps, 30+ integrations.
Company background. Founded after founder's wife had difficulty managing Ob/Gyn practice. Team includes former physicians, software engineers, product experts.
IVF EMR app page on support site. Details cycle management, oocyte tracking, semen analysis, cryopreservation, exam diagrams, e-prescribing, fax, secure messaging.
ENT specialty module page. ENT-specific templates, picklists, exam diagrams with annotation, integrated with nAble 4.0c web EMR.

FindEMR listing. Confirms cloud-based EMR/PM, highlights IVF specialty with donor portal and barcode scanning. Lists specialties: Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Ob/Gyn. Rating 4/5 from 10 reviews.
Business-Software.com EHR review. Lists specialty-specific templates, HPI templates, LabCorp interfaces, patient portal, scanned charts, ePrescribing, growth charts, visit-level coding. Founded 1999.
SelectHub listing. 96% user satisfaction from 8 reviews. Notes seamless integration and reliable support as strengths; patient portal usability as weakness.
EMRSystems listing. Confirms specialties: Cardiology, Pediatrics, Internal Medicine, Family Practice, Gynecology, Obstetrics. Tailored for small to medium practices.
